responsibility: Implements edge-specific range extraction for the ranger infrastructure. It recognizes terminating GIMPLE conditionals and switches that constrain outgoing CFG edges, computes the boolean [0,0]/[1,1] ranges for conditional edges, lazily derives and caches per-edge integer ranges for switch cases and defaults, and exposes the statement responsible for each outgoing edge range.
same_name_distinction: Implements edge-range computation details, including detecting terminating gcond/gswitch statements, building boolean edge ranges, lazily computing switch-case edge ranges, and caching them per edge. Unlike gcc/gimple-range-edge.h, it contains the operational logic behind gimple_outgoing_range and the helper routines it declares.
